text:
Noor Hale: quick brainstorm 1: want a short benchmark narrative for launch that stands apart from the usual 2-axis shot. thinking a micro 'latency vs cost quadrant' hero that places hosted/dedicated/private into quadrants so readers instantly see tradeoffs. who wants to own copy, data, visual?
Calvin Brooks: I like quadrant idea. data owner here. i'll run a compact bench and map each deployment to (95th latency ms, cost per 1k) and we'll place points in the quadrant. will normalize cost per 1k.
Ivy Park: i'll take copy and the landing page methodology paragraph. short headline + one-sentence kicker + CTA. suggest headline: "Where latency meets dollars: serving choices that change the experience" body: "We mapped 95th-percentile latency against per-1k token cost across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. See which quadrant your app belongs to and the levers that move you toward the sweet spot." CTA: "Register for the bench webinar: https://redwood.example/webinar-bench"
Noor Hale: nice. inbound routing plan? want to route enterprise leads differently and capture a single pain checkbox pre-reg.
Ivy Park: HubSpot form -> tag=bench-quadrant -> hidden field: infra_interest -> one-click pain: [Latency, Cost, Reliability, Compliance]. enterprise domains -> SDR. also add a boolean field "wants-demo" so solutions can fast follow.
Calvin Brooks: running bench with seq=400, batch=auto, KV warm, quant=int8 where applicable. sample CSV for mock: ```model,mode,95pct_ms,cost_per_1k
cerulean-7b,hosted,98,0.92
cerulean-7b,dedicated,72,0.60
cerulean-7b,private,85,0.74
```
Ivy Park: for social copy keep conservative: "Up to" language + link to methodology. sample: "Serving choices change both your tail latency and token bill. See where hosted, dedicated, and private fall in our latency vs cost quadrant. Register: https://redwood.example/webinar-bench :sparkles:"
metrics-bot: Webinar scheduled: "Benchmark Quadrant: Latency vs Cost Playbook" 2026-04-14 11:00 PDT. Reg page: https://redwood.example/webinar-bench
Noor Hale: design ask: show three labeled points (H,D,P) with hover text: deployment, seq, batch, quant. add small legend explaining quadrant axes: left=low cost, right=high cost, top=high latency, bottom=low latency.
Calvin Brooks: will provide normalized cost-per-1k and raw ms for latency. also include a short explainer sentence per point: hosted = "fast setup, higher token unit cost", dedicated = "best cost per token at scale", private = "balance of control and mid-range cost".
Ivy Park: landing page must include brief methodology (seq length, batching, KV warm status, quant), CSV link, and a small note: "results vary by model and workload". add a footnote: "cost estimates exclude infra amortization and storage."
Noor Hale: timeline: data & CSV by EOD, copy + landing draft by tomorrow AM, design mock by tomorrow noon, email flow + form by Wed EOD.
Calvin Brooks: posting final CSV here when done. will also include a one-paragraph methodology blurb for the landing page.
Ivy Park: single metric we emphasize in CTA? i'm leaning to the quadrant insight: "Which quadrant is your app in?" as the hook.
Noor Hale: agree. CTA on social and slide: "Find your quadrant 1 Register". good. keep claims conservative and link to full bench repo. reconvene after csv. :white_check_mark:
